Package logic.game

Class Player

java.lang.Object
objects.BaseObject
objects.Human
logic.game.Player
All Implemented Interfaces:
Attackable, Interactable
public class Player extends Human
Represents the player character controlled by the user. Extends Human and adds stamina management, damage/healing mechanics, and the ability to attack other Attackable entities.
